disabled_only.description: Only dump or list disabled principals (--disabled).

enabled_only.description: Only dump or list enabled principals (--enabled).

encryption_type.description: Override default key encryption type. Valid values: aes128, aes256, 3des, des-md5, des-md4, des-crc, arcfour.

operation.description: The operation to perform. Valid values: list, add, modify, remove, dump, key-add, key-remove.

principal.description: The principal name to target for operations like list, add, or modify.

priority.description: Specify key priority (--priority). Higher value means higher priority.

random_key.description: Use a random key (--random). Default if no password or random is not specified.

realm.description: The Kerberos realm to operate on.

salt.description: Use specified salt for deriving key (--salt). Defaults to realm+principal concatenation.

show_keys.description: Print cryptographic key and password in hostkey format (--keys).
